host.ask: PC running the Neware BTS server (the API listens there)
host.help: The Windows PC with BTS Server and BTS Client 8.0. Enable the API in the client under Help > Mode settings (Neware may have to supply an activation key).

user.ask: BTS user name the API logs in with
user.help: The BTS client login; the default installation uses admin.

step_dir.ask: Folder, reachable from this machine, where step files are written (a share of a folder on the BTS PC)
step_dir.help: The BTS server opens the step file by its own path: put that in step_dir_on_server if it differs from this one.

port.ask: TCP port of the BTS API

step_dir_on_server.ask: The step folder as the BTS server sees it (Windows path)

backup_dir.ask: Folder on the BTS PC where the server backs up test data (the start command names it)

default_channel.ask: Pipeline id the per-channel signals read until one is written

voltage_max_v.ask: Highest voltage limit any step may ask for (chemistry cap)

voltage_min_v.ask: Lowest discharge cut-off any step may ask for

poll_s.ask: Seconds between inquire polls while following a channel

max_run_hours.ask: Longest protocol before the job is failed

voltage_scale.ask: Multiplier from the API's voltage field to volts

current_scale.ask: Multiplier from the API's current field to amperes (0.001 for mA)

capacity_scale.ask: Multiplier from the API's capacity field to Ah (0.001 for mAh)
